messages:
alex: Morning team, just unboxed my company laptop (MBP M2). MDM shows enrolled but FileVault says 'Pending admin approval' and the enable button is disabled. I don't see any prompts. Anyone know what that means?

it-support: welcome alex! :wave: That message usually means the MDM sent an FDE enable command but our policy requires a local admin authorisation token (SecureToken) for the user. Is your account the device owner/account created during setup?

alex: yes the account is alex (admin). I restored my data from iCloud during setup though.

it-security: tagging in: if the account was restored/migrated it may not have SecureToken. Can you run `sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus $(whoami)` and `sudo fdesetup status` and paste outputs?

alex: pasted output: `Secure token is DISABLED for user alex` and `FileVault is Off.`

it-support: okay. Fastest path: we can push a temporary admin via MDM to grant your user a SecureToken and then trigger escrow. Do you want to do that now?

alex: yes please, no reboot if possible.

it-support: pushing temp admin rdw-temp-now (expires 2h). You'll see an MDM prompt. Authorize it using your password.

(mdm-bot posts): MDM: CreateLocalAdmin rdw-temp-now issued for serial=C02ZXY12345

alex: got the prompt, ran the Terminal command and authorized.

it-support: great. From the temp admin run: `sudo sysadminctl -secureTokenOn alex -password <your_pw> -adminUser rdw-temp-now -adminPassword TempPass!`

alex: ran, returned exit 0. `sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus alex` now shows ENABLED.

it-support: perfect. Now enable FileVault with `sudo fdesetup enable -user alex` and follow the prompts. We'll monitor the escrow.

alex: enabled, got a recovery key. mdm-bot: `Recovery escrow received serial=C02ZXY12345 user=alex status=SUCCESS`. Web console now shows 'Encryption: Managed'. Thanks!

it-support: removing rdw-temp-now in 10m. Follow-up: if you used iCloud keychain, you might need to reauthorize some apps. Otherwise all good. Ticket IT-4750 opened with steps.

alex: awesome, appreciate the quick help :tada:
